1.name: Concussive Combustion
1.summary: Become a living bomb, dealing spirit damage and applying stun to all nearby enemies after a delay.Once cast, Concussive Combustion cannot be interrupted.

2.name: Storm Cloud
2.summary: Channel an expanding storm cloud around you that damages all enemies within its radius.

3.name: Assassinate
3.summary: Use your scoped rifle to fire a powerful shot over long distances.

4.name: Soul Exchange
4.summary: Swaps health levels with an enemy target.

6.name: Seismic Impact
6.summary: Leap high into the air before crashing into the ground, dealing spirit damage and applying stun.

7.name: Telekinesis
7.summary: Lift an enemy hero into the air and then slam them towards the target location.

8.name: Heavy Barrage
8.summary: Unleashes a volley of rockets that home in on a targeted location.

10.name: Paradoxical Swap
10.summary: Fire a projectile that swaps your position with the target enemy hero.

11.name: Singularity
11.summary: Create a singularity in your hands, dealing spirit damage over time, applying stun, and pulling in nearby enemies.

12.name: Frozen Shelter
12.summary: Target yourself or a Hero to freeze the air and create an impenetrable dome around them.

13.name: Bullet Dance
13.summary: Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with perfect accuracy and added Bullet Damage.

14.name: Spirit Lasso
14.summary: Throw out your lasso, dealing spirit damage, pulling, and applying stun.Using a Bounce Pad extends the duration of Spirit Lasso.

15.name: Hyper Beam
15.summary: Channel a powerful torrent of energy that deals spirit damage and applies slow.

16.name: Return to Shadows
16.summary: Instantly turn to shadows, becoming untargetable, gaining bonus move speed, and dealing spirit damage.

17.name: Guided Owl
17.summary: After 1.5s cast time, launch a spirit owl that you control and which explodes on impact, damaging and stunning enemies.

18.name: Combo
18.summary: Hold the target in place, stunning them and dealing damage during the channel.

20.name: Air Drop
20.summary: Grab an ally and take flight with them.

25.name: Last Stand
25.summary: After charging for 2s, release pulses that damage enemies and heal you based on the damage done.

27.name: Shadow Transformation
27.summary: Become infused with Yamato's shadow soul.

31.name: Death Slam
31.summary: Focus on enemies to connect whips to them.

35.name: Goo Ball
35.summary: Morph into a large goo ball that deals damage and stuns enemies on impact.

50.name: Affliction
50.summary: Applies damage over time to enemies nearby.Affliction's damage is non-lethal and does not apply item procs.

52.name: Traveler
52.summary: Target a location on the minimap.

60.name: Audience Participation
60.summary: Copy the Ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time.

63.name: Nox Nostra

64.name: Eternal Night
64.summary: Surround nearby enemy heroes in darkness, severely limiting their vision of other units.

66.name: Shocking Reanimation
66.summary: Release a wave after taking lethal damage, applying a diminishing slow.

67.name: Rallying Charge
67.summary: Release a wave of spectral knights and steeds that charge across the entire city, healing allies and dealing spirit damage to enemies.

69.name: Hotel Guest
69.summary: Send the target's physical body to be a guest at the Baroness Hotel.

77.name: Itani Lo Sahn
77.summary: Charge up and perform a long range slash.

78.name: Close The Deal

79.name: Naptime
79.summary: Cast your gaze forward, piercing walls and floors.

80.name: Lycan Curse
80.summary: Passive: Dealing damage generates bloodlust, increased at low health.

81.name: Shining Wonder
81.summary: Launch a deadly orb of light that deals spirit damage and applies slow and reduces Dash Distance on impact.

87.summary: Open your bag and reveal the horrors you carry inside, dealing spirit damage over time to enemies in front of you.
